headline: Anthropic Bridges the Gap Between LLMs and Institutional Banking Workflows
lede: This framework offers a modular suite of reference agents and connectors for investment banking and equity research. It streamlines complex tasks like DCF modeling and audit reconciliation through standardized integrations with industry-standard data sources.

headline: Substrate Orchestrates High-Density Agent Swarms on Shared Hardware
lede: Agent Substrate introduces a specialized control plane that multiplexes stateful actors across Kubernetes clusters. By leveraging microVMs for sub-second state persistence, it reduces the resource overhead typically associated with massive multi-agent deployments.

headline: Univer Provides a Modular Canvas for Embeddable Office Applications
lede: This isomorphic framework enables developers to inject native-like spreadsheet and document editing capabilities into any web or Node.js platform. Its plugin-first architecture supports both rapid presets and deep customization for data-heavy workflows.

headline: Claude Code Templates Streamline Complex Agent Development Environments
lede: This repository aggregates community-driven skills and slash commands to personalize the Claude Code experience. It adds real-time session monitoring and infrastructure health checks to the developer workflow through an intuitive CLI interface.

headline: Google AX Brings Kubernetes Primitives to Autonomous Agent Workloads
lede: Designed for production-grade agentic systems, Google AX manages state persistence and secure resource isolation with declarative code. It simplifies the operational lifecycle by treating millions of autonomous agents as manageable tasks within a standard cluster environment.

headline: MVT Automates Forensic Analysis for Mobile Device Security
lede: The Mobile Verification Toolkit provides researchers with a robust command-line interface to identify indicators of compromise on Android and iOS devices. Its modular plugin architecture allows investigators to keep pace with evolving threats to digital privacy.

headline: Treg Centralizes External Tool Access for AI Agent Architectures
lede: Treg acts as a secure, server-side relay that simplifies how agents connect to diverse third-party APIs. By standardizing authentication and enabling pay-per-call access, it removes the need for individual service subscriptions in agentic workflows.

headline: Video-Use Automates Post-Production Through Natural Language Agentic Control
lede: This framework converts video editing into a conversational, strategy-driven process by treating footage as structured text. It handles audio cleanup and visual evaluation, allowing for automated assembly without traditional manual timeline manipulation.
